producer_report.summary: Added docs/spec.toml (Olympus requirements, each with verbatim cited quotes, plus open questions) and xtask/tests/spec.rs (checker, four specific-string negative cases, coverage by heading, schema, open questions, and a direct boundary-word test on the file read from disk). Added D111, a CHANGELOG entry and enforcement row M33. In this round I added the missing ontology term 'spec'. That term made the ontology test, which pins the exact set of terms, fail, so I added "spec" to its list and dropped "seven" from the test's name. fmt and clippy are clean. `cargo test -p xtask --test spec` passes 15 of 15. The full `cargo test --locked` still has one failure, `every_test_named_in_the_enforcement_map_exists` in policy.rs. It lists the new tests from the M33 row as missing because that test finds Rust files with `git ls-files` and spec.rs is not tracked yet. I may not stage files and did not touch policy.rs. All 11 names exist in spec.rs, and I expect the test to pass once Athena commits the candidate. I did not re-run the suite after that.

checks_run.note: One failure: policy.rs every_test_named_in_the_enforcement_map_exists, because new untracked files are invisible to git ls-files; the named tests exist in xtask/tests/spec.rs. The first lines of this test run printed in full; the rest was truncated, and everything shown in the visible part of the output passed. Then ran xtask policy alone with the same single failure.
9 of 9 pass after the term was added.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test parses docs/spec.toml and passes; in-memory negative cases each fail the checker for (a) a quote not a verbatim substring of BRIEF.md after collapsing whitespace, (b) a duplicate id, (c) a supersedes target that does not exist, (d) a requirement with no source.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test --locked -p xtask --test spec` passes 15 of 15, including the_spec_parses_and_every_quote_is_verbatim_in_the_brief, a_quote_that_is_not_in_the_brief_is_flagged, a_duplicate_id_is_flagged, a_supersedes_target_that_does_not_exist_is_flagged and a_requirement_with_no_source_is_flagged. `cargo test -p xtask` as a whole still fails on the policy.rs test described under the policy criterion.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test counts requirements by their sources' headings and finds at least one for each of R1–R8, Phases 1–6 with their acceptance, section 10 (Final system acceptance), and 2026-10-17 decisions 3C, 4A, 5A and 7A.
criteria_check.evidence: requirements_are_counted_by_their_sources_headings and a_heading_with_no_requirement_is_named_as_a_gap pass in `cargo test -p xtask --test spec`.

criteria_check.criterion: Each requirement in docs/spec.toml has an id, a plain statement, a kind (goal, requirement, constraint, acceptance), a status (active or superseded), and one or more sources (verbatim quote plus heading). Duplicates across sections are merged into one requirement with several sources. Requirement-bearing sentences in Olympus sections 1–10, the governing philosophy and the 2026-10-17 addenda are covered.
criteria_check.evidence: a_bad_kind_status_or_empty_statement_is_flagged, unknown_fields_in_the_spec_are_refused and the coverage tests pass. Coverage requires every Olympus section, the governing philosophy and the addenda. I did not audit the merging of duplicates sentence by sentence.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml records at least one open question with both verbatim quotes where Sri's words conflict or leave a choice open; it is recorded, not resolved.
criteria_check.evidence: open_questions_keep_both_quotes_and_resolve_nothing passes. It requires at least one question, at least two verbatim sources each, and no resolution field.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml has no statement about who runs Athena or where; `cargo test -p xtask` shows xtask/tests/policy.rs still passes.
criteria_check.evidence: The spec side is met: the_spec_refers_to_no_one_who_runs_athena_or_where and a_banned_word_planted_in_the_spec_is_flagged pass, and policy.rs athena_refers_to_no_one_who_runs_it_or_where passes. But policy.rs every_test_named_in_the_enforcement_map_exists fails in this snapshot because the untracked spec.rs is invisible to `git ls-files`. All 11 names in row M33 exist in spec.rs. Expected to pass once the files are committed; not re-run since.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo test`: all clean and passing.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` are clean. `cargo test --locked` fails only on the untracked-file policy.rs test described above. The ontology test failure I introduced is fixed. athena-cli ontology tests pass 9 of 9.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the spec; docs/decisions.md records the spec format and the choice of TOML with alternatives (Markdown with ids, JSON, YAML). No earlier Athena brief parts are specified; no reader or prompt is changed.
criteria_check.evidence: git status shows CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md modified (D111 heading present at docs/decisions.md line 2580). No reader or prompt files changed. Besides the listed deliverables, the only other edit is the ontology.rs pinned-term test.

open_issues: The one remaining full-suite failure is expected to clear once spec.rs is tracked. Please confirm after the candidate is committed.
I edited crates/athena-cli/tests/ontology.rs, which is not a listed deliverable. The change is one pinned name added and the test renamed to drop 'seven'.
2A and the 'The operator is the brain for now' addendum are deliberately not covered: they concern who runs Athena or where, which the criteria and out-of-scope list rule out.
mistakes: In the earlier round I added the enforcement row and the spec but left out the ontology term. This round I added the term, and the ontology test then failed until I updated its pinned list.
learnings: policy.rs finds Rust files and checks the enforcement map using `git ls-files`, so new untracked test files make `every_test_named_in_the_enforcement_map_exists` fail until Athena commits them.
crates/athena-cli/tests/ontology.rs pins the exact set of ontology term names, so adding a term requires editing that test.
xtask already had toml, serde, regex and athena-context as dev-dependencies, so xtask/Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock were not changed.
desires: Permission to stage files, or a policy.rs check that uses untracked files too, so the enforcement-map test could be verified before the candidate is committed.
